description:
hunk ships as a Bun single-file executable; Bun's default x64 build targets x86-64-v3 and faults on `shlx` (BMI2) on pre-Haswell CPUs. shirka is a Xeon E5-2697 v2 (Ivy Bridge): AVX/SSE4.2 but no AVX2/BMI2/FMA, so the binary SIGILLs on every invocation.

That failure is silent in a pager seat: the pager dies and takes the output with it, so `git diff` and `jj log` came back completely blank (hunk was wired to both core.pager and jj ui.pager).

Upstream (modem-dev/hunk) publishes no -baseline artifact - only hunkdiff-linux-x64.tar.gz - so there is no drop-in fix. Verified a baseline build IS possible from source (pristine bun-linux-x64-baseline + FHS shim so /proc/self/exe resolves, then patchelf the output), but that needs bwrap at build time which the nix sandbox does not allow.

Fix: gate programs.hunk.enable on the already-declared-but-unused `nehalem` machine feature. Falls back to delta, which keeps git [pager] diff/show/log/blame and the jj delta scope; jj ui.pager returns to :builtin.
title: Disable hunk on pre-Haswell CPUs (nehalem)
